title: Version 3 Futuristic Neo-Tokyo Landing Page & Frictionless Conversion Engine
objective: Overhaul the public front door of NIHOMI.COM into a futuristic Neo-Tokyo learning showcase. Integrate the interactive 'First Aha Moment' Hiragana canvas, live interactive previews of the Tokyo Konbini POS Cashier simulator and CBT Exam OS, clear commercial pricing matrix, and seamless Google OAuth/email modal triggers without any cognitive clutter or legacy redirection.
in_scope: Upgrade src/v2/pages/V2LandingPage.tsx with high-impact Neo-Tokyo visual polish (#0A0A12 obsidian slate, crimson/amber accents, subtle Hanabi canvas particles).
Embed the frictionless zero-sign-in 'First Aha Moment' Hiragana micro-demo (あ → い → あい ❤️) right in the hero section.
Showcase live interactive feature cards for the CBT Mock Exam OS (Pass/Cutoff matrix), Tokyo 7-Eleven POS simulator, and JIS Rirekisho Studio.
Integrate unified AuthModal triggers so Google login or email sign-in preserves landing context and seamlessly enters the V3 Dashboard.
Author automated test suite scripts/test-v3-wp05-landing-and-conversion.cjs with 100% green assertions and browser screenshot evidence.
out_of_scope: Modifying backend PostgreSQL database schema (schema is stable and persisted).
External production marketing ad buys (reserved for GTM execution).
acceptance_criteria: Landing page loads with zero console errors and authentic Neo-Tokyo dark aesthetic.
Interactive Hiragana demo allows clicking strokes/hearing audio without login barrier.
CTA buttons ('লার্নিং শুরু করুন', 'ফ্রি ট্রায়াল', 'লগইন') trigger AuthModal cleanly.
Full TypeScript typecheck passes with 0 errors (npx tsc --noEmit).
Production build compiles cleanly (npm run build).
Automated test suite passes with 100% green assertions and captures screenshot evidence across mobile and desktop.
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify type safety.
Run npm run build to verify production bundling.
Verify DOM elements for hero, Hiragana demo, CTA buttons, and auth modal.
risks: Heavy canvas animations slowing down low-power mobile devices (mitigated by requestAnimationFrame throttling and will-change CSS optimization).
